name: Failed Lich Template (CR +0)
body:
Acquired Template: Any Evil Creature capable of casting animate dead

Through impatient, flawed, or corrupted necromantic rituals, an arcane or divine spellcaster seeking lichdom transforms into a shambling, spellcasting undead horror—a zombie wizard trapped in the delusional belief that they have achieved immortal mastery.

TEMPLATE RULES

Type: Type changes to Undead. Do not recalculate Base Attack Bonus, saves, or skill ranks.
Senses: Gains darkvision 60 ft.
Armor Class: Gains a +2 natural armor bonus (or retains existing, whichever is higher), but suffers a -2 penalty due to reduced Dexterity.
Hit Dice: Convert all racial Hit Dice to d8s; class Hit Dice remain unchanged. As Undead, use Charisma modifier to determine bonus hit points instead of Constitution. Failed Liches gain the Toughness feat automatically.
Defensive Abilities: Gains Undead traits, +2 Turn Resistance, and DR 5/slashing.
Speed & Actions: Gains the staggered condition (can take only a single move or standard action each round).
Attacks: Gains a primary Slam attack dealing 1d6 damage (Medium) or appropriate for size.
Abilities: Str +4, Dex -4, Con —, Int +0, Wis +0, Cha +0.
Challenge Rating: Same as base creature.

ABOUT

True lichdom requires profound discipline, vast wealth, and legendary arcane fortitude. When arrogant necromancers attempt shortcuts or use counterfeit formulae, the resulting ritual curses their physical form, rotting away their flesh while trapping their intellect inside a decaying carcass.

The tragedy of the Failed Lich is their total detachment from reality: they guard false phylacteries that hold no soul and issue grandiose decrees to shambling minions, entirely oblivious that they have become the very abominations they once commanded.
